name: the-docket
description: The Docket: a ledger of rulings that governs a codebase, with a hook that prints what governs a region before an edit and a judge that reads every stop against the rulings.

plugins.name: the-docket
plugins.description: A ledger of rulings that governs a codebase. Before an edit: what governs this region. At stop: a judge that reads the diff against the rulings. At a decision: a record where it will be found. At a new project: a spine before the first line. Across time: what changed in the law.
